text.hi: किताब: एक समूह कॉलम A के सवाल पूछेगा, दूसरा कॉलम B से जवाब देगा। आज Tinku यक्ष है, तुम युधिष्ठिर!
text.hinglish: Kitaab: ek samooh column A ke sawaal poochhega, doosra column B se jawab dega. Aaj Tinku Yaksha hai, tum Yudhishthir!
text.en: The book: one group asks the questions in column A, the other answers from column B. Today Tinku is the Yaksha and you are Yudhishthira!

turns.tinku: Which is the best road to Heaven?

meaning.hi: स्वर्ग का सबसे अच्छा रास्ता कौन सा है?
meaning.hinglish: Swarg ka sabse achha raasta kaun sa hai?

replies.say: Virtue is the best road to Heaven.

meaning.hi: सद्गुण स्वर्ग का सबसे अच्छा रास्ता है।
meaning.hinglish: Sadgun swarg ka sabse achha raasta hai.

turns.tinku: Which is the worst enemy of man?

meaning.hi: इंसान का सबसे बड़ा दुश्मन कौन है?
meaning.hinglish: Insaan ka sabse bada dushman kaun hai?

replies.say: Anger is the worst enemy of man.

meaning.hi: क्रोध इंसान का सबसे बड़ा दुश्मन है।
meaning.hinglish: Krodh insaan ka sabse bada dushman hai.

turns.tinku: What is heavier than the earth and the clouds?

meaning.hi: धरती और बादलों से भारी क्या है?
meaning.hinglish: Dharti aur baadalon se bhaari kya hai?

turns.tinku: What is the way to be happy?

meaning.hi: ख़ुश रहने का तरीक़ा क्या है?
meaning.hinglish: Khush rehne ka tareeqa kya hai?

replies.say: To tell the truth and be kind.

instruction.en: Join each question to its answer

pairs.left: Which man is rich and poor at the same time?
pairs.right: The man who has much but gives nothing.

meaning.hi: जिसके पास बहुत है पर देता कुछ नहीं
meaning.hinglish: jiske paas bahut hai par deta kuchh nahi

pairs.left: How may a poor man become rich?

pairs.right: One who is unaffected by joy and sorrow.

meaning.hi: जिस पर सुख-दुख का असर न हो
meaning.hinglish: jis par sukh-dukh ka asar na ho
